definitions: A propulsion system that combines an electric motor with a propeller to generate thrust, commonly found in aircraft, drones, and marine vessels.
The integrated assembly of a motor and a propeller designed to convert rotational energy into propulsive force.
examples: The drone's motor-propeller system was highly efficient.
Engineers optimized the motor-propeller system for maximum thrust.
Failure of a single motor-propeller system can lead to instability.
